title: Type Test
subtitle: Inspired by the four-letter personality types
footer: For fun and conversation, not a clinical or official assessment.

dimensions.name: Energy
dimensions.same: You recharge the same way, so plans that suit one of you usually suit both.
dimensions.differ: One of you fills up around people, the other in quiet. Make room for both.

dimensions.name: Focus
dimensions.same: You take in the world the same way, so you rarely talk past each other.
dimensions.differ: One of you sees the details, the other the big picture. Together you see the whole thing.

dimensions.name: Deciding
dimensions.same: You make decisions the same way, which keeps things simple.
dimensions.differ: One leads with the head, the other with the heart. Say which one you need in the moment.

dimensions.name: Pace
dimensions.same: You agree on how much to plan, which saves a lot of arguments.
dimensions.differ: One likes a plan, the other likes options. Agree what's fixed and leave the rest open.

ISTJ.name: The Steady Hand
ISTJ.blurb: Reliable, thorough and quietly loyal. You keep your word and your promises.

ISFJ.name: The Quiet Keeper
ISFJ.blurb: Caring and dependable. You remember the little things that matter to people.

INFJ.name: The Lantern
INFJ.blurb: Thoughtful and deep. You see what people need before they say it.

INTJ.name: The Long Thinker
INTJ.blurb: Independent and strategic. You like a good plan and a better idea.

ISTP.name: The Tinkerer
ISTP.blurb: Calm and hands-on. You figure things out by taking them apart.

ISFP.name: The Gentle Maker
ISFP.blurb: Easy-going and creative. You live by your own quiet values.

INFP.name: The Daydreamer
INFP.blurb: Idealistic and kind. Your inner world is rich and full of meaning.

INTP.name: The Puzzle Solver
INTP.blurb: Curious and logical. You love working out how everything fits.

ESTP.name: The Live Wire
ESTP.blurb: Bold and quick. You'd rather try it than talk about it.

ESFP.name: The Spark
ESFP.blurb: Warm and playful. You turn an ordinary day into a good one.

ENFP.name: The Firework
ENFP.blurb: Enthusiastic and imaginative. You see possibilities everywhere.

ENTP.name: The Idea Machine
ENTP.blurb: Inventive and witty. You love a debate and a fresh angle.

ESTJ.name: The Captain
ESTJ.blurb: Organised and decisive. You get people and plans moving.

ESFJ.name: The Host
ESFJ.blurb: Friendly and generous. You make everyone feel looked after.

ENFJ.name: The Rallying Cry
ENFJ.blurb: Encouraging and warm. You bring out the best in people.

ENTJ.name: The Strategist
ENTJ.blurb: Confident and driven. You see the goal and the path to it.
